name: cancellation
why: Folding a cancellation kept BOTH 'plans to sail next month' and 'trip is off' — a self-contradicting memory — hence the REPLACE rule. Two sessions: the first makes the plan (checked: the plan must be recorded, or the fixture proves nothing), the second cancels it. After the second fold, a line still stating the plan without saying it is off is a contradiction. The boat itself is durable and must survive. The plan must never be an auto-FACT at either stage (it is scheduled). Label note: 'might try again next year' is a tentative, not the plan kept alive, so it is not counted as a contradiction.

messages: *spreads the chart across the table* Okay. I've decided. Next month we sail the Kestrel up to Orkney. Just you and me.
*Mira's eyes go wide.* "Orkney? In your little boat? Jonah, you're serious."
Deadly serious. I've had the Kestrel eight years, she can handle it. We leave on the fourteenth.
*She laughs and traces the route with a finger.* "Then I'm learning proper knots this week."
I'll teach you the bowline tomorrow.
"Deal. And I'm packing the good biscuits."

forbid.label: scheduled trip stored as a durable fact

messages: *sits down heavily* Bad news. Mum fell and broke her hip. I'm going to be back and forth to the hospital for weeks. Orkney's off — I've cancelled the trip.
*Mira takes his hand.* "Oh, Jonah. I'm so sorry. Forget the trip, your mum comes first."
Yeah. The Kestrel can stay in the marina this season. Maybe next year.

forbid.label: stale plan kept (no cancellation on the line)
scheduled trip stored as a durable fact
